name: Blueberry Cheesecake Doughnuts
subtitle: Fried doughnuts with blueberry and soft-cheese filling
description: Light enriched doughnuts are filled with blueberry compote and a vanilla soft-cheese mixture, then coated in sugar.

ingredients.item: strong white bread flour plus extra for dusting
golden caster sugar plus extra to coat the doughnuts
vegetable oil for proving and deep-frying

instructions.text: Warm the milk and butter together until the butter melts. Set aside until just warm.
Mix the flour, golden caster sugar, and yeast in a large bowl. Add the warm milk mixture and egg, then stir to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, until smooth. Transfer it to an oiled bowl, cover, and leave to rise until doubled in size, about 2 hours.
Cook the blueberries with 1 tablespoon of the caster sugar for about 5 minutes, until softened and jammy. Cool completely.
Beat the soft cheese with the remaining caster sugar and vanilla extract until smooth. Transfer the mixture and cooled blueberry compote to separate piping bags, if using.
Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide it into 12 pieces. Shape each into a smooth ball, place on a floured tray, cover, and leave to puff for 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil for deep-frying. Fry the doughnuts in batches until golden brown and cooked through; the centers should reach 160°F.
Drain briefly, then roll the warm doughnuts in the extra golden caster sugar and leave them to cool slightly.
Make a small opening in each doughnut and fill with the soft-cheese mixture and blueberry compote. Serve.
